title: MV Simple way to make a spinning obstacle?

posts.author: Meredith
posts.body: I was looking for a way to create a spinning fire bar obstacle in the overworld, like the ones in Super Mario, for example. However, I honestly have no clue on how to program it in the game (using RPG Maker base commands). Does anybody have an idea or a tip on how to realize it? I'm also open to JavaScript solutions.

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
the basis with character sheet or by image on mapX and mapY position.
